other_conditions: Possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Law
Law graduate who passed out in 2016 or later
Name entered in the rolls of Advocates maintained by the Andhra Pradesh State Bar Council under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961
Within the first three years of practice as of the date of the Government Order
Junior Advocate shall not exceed thirty‑five (35) years of age as of the date of the Government Order
One Family, One Benefit scheme applies (family includes husband, wife, and their children)
benefits_summary: A monthly stipend of ₹5,000 for the first three years of practice.
